For Flatpak releases, see https://github.com/FreesmTeam/flatpak#usage
CurseForge downloads
CurseForge is rolling out mandatory API key authentication for direct downloads from its CDN (edge.forgecdn.net). Make sure you're on an up-to-date launcher build so CurseForge content keeps downloading without interruption. Details: https://blog.curseforge.com/introducing-api-key-authentication-for-curseforge-file-downloads/
